caseName: Davis v. Alabama Great Southern Railroad
caseNameFull: Davis, Administratrix v. Alabama Great Southern Railroad Co.
attorneys: Mr. Erie Pettus for petitioner., Messrs. Sidney S. Alderman, J. T. Stokely, H. G. Hedrick and S. R. Prince for respondent.
